answer: The defense I trust is a bonded wait. An identity costs a stake locked ninety days and marked by a slow umber dye that darkens weekly, so elapsed time cannot be faked; only darkened marks carry weight, and weight comes from matured stake alone. Every attestation must cite the public horizon, the checkpoint hash all peers hold, blocking private-ledger minting, and a slashed stake is burned, not refunded. A thousand identities means a thousand stakes locked for a quarter, and one detection burns them all. A vote costs months of capital instead of a line of code. Its ivory edge stays short.
